primitives.name: Payment Route Authenticator
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Confirm one usable payment route** — A buyer needs a truthful way to pay after agreeing.
primitives.assumptions: Route R is bijective between B and S; payment validity is encoded in R's integrity.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When R fails validation, B→S transaction halts.

primitives.name: Message Reviewer
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Review and manually send one message** — The next reviewed prospect is lead-acquisition-tailwind-cycles.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'M': 'message content (dimensionless)', 'P': 'prospect identifier (dimensionless)', 'T': 'time of review (seconds since epoch)'}
primitives.assumptions: M is a function of P; T ensures temporal ordering of reviews.
primitives.breakdown_regime: If M is malformed, P is flagged for re-evaluation.

layer2.mapping: GSE's message state transition depends on GSI's review confidence score.

primitives.name: Restore Drill Verifier
primitives.verbatim_quote: **Run the disposable restore drill** — First-cash evidence must be recoverable.
primitives.assumptions: E is recoverable iff C and I pass local verification.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Failure of E recovery implies system rollback to last known stable state.

layer2.mapping: GSI's evidence integrity checks mirror GSE's recovery state validation.
layer2.telemetry: Recovery success rate and evidence consistency metrics
